title: Morpheus8 Cost in Dubai: Face, Neck and Body Prices
h1: Morpheus8 cost in Dubai: face, neck and body prices explained
desc: What Morpheus8 Pro costs in Dubai: face or neck AED 2,999 + VAT, face and neck AED 3,500 + VAT, a 3-session package and body prices, with PRP included.
answer: At Skin & Laser in Dubai Marina, Morpheus8 Pro costs AED 2,999 + VAT for the face, AED 2,999 + VAT for the neck and AED 3,500 + VAT for face and neck in one session. A face and neck package of 3 sessions is AED 1,750 + VAT per session (AED 5,250 + VAT in total). Body areas cost AED 1,999 to AED 5,500 + VAT, and every price includes PRP.
body:
## What decides the price

Morpheus8 Pro is priced by treatment area, not by the number of needle passes or the depth used. A larger area takes longer and uses more tips, so the body costs more than a single facial zone. Every session at Skin & Laser includes PRP, which is applied to the treated skin to support healing, so there is no separate PRP charge.

## Face and neck prices

- **Face:** AED 2,999 + VAT per session
- **Neck:** AED 2,999 + VAT per session
- **Face and neck together:** AED 3,500 + VAT per session
- **Face and neck, package of 3:** AED 1,750 + VAT per session, AED 5,250 + VAT in total

Treating the face and neck together in one visit costs less than booking them separately, and the package of 3 is the lowest price per session if your doctor recommends a course.

## Body prices

Body areas start at AED 1,999 + VAT for the half abdomen, knees, body scars or underarm area, and go up to AED 3,500 + VAT for the full abdomen, inner or outer thighs or half arms and AED 5,500 + VAT for the full thighs. The 3D body option is AED 4,500 + VAT. For [stretch marks](/stretch-marks-treatment-dubai/), the price is set by the size of the area, so a small patch on the hips costs less than the full abdomen.

## How many sessions to budget for

- **Skin tightening and texture:** often 1 to 3 sessions
- **Acne scars:** usually 3 sessions, 4 to 6 weeks apart
- **Stretch marks:** usually 3 or more sessions, depending on how old and deep they are

Collagen keeps building for about 3 months after each session, so many people judge the result at the 3-month mark before deciding on more. Your doctor confirms the number of sessions at your consultation, so you know the total before you start.

## Optional extras

Exosomes can be added to a session for AED 750 + VAT. They are not needed for a good result; your doctor will only suggest them if they suit your plan.

## Paying in instalments

You can split the cost of Morpheus8 Pro into 4 interest-free payments with Tabby or Tamara, which makes a course of 3 sessions easier to plan. Ask at reception or on WhatsApp when you book.

## Is the cheapest option the best value?

A single face session costs the least up front, but if your skin needs a course, the 3-session face and neck package usually gives the best value. If your main concern is lifting rather than texture, a one-session lifting treatment such as [HIFU](/treatments/hifu-dubai/) or [Ultherapy](/treatments/ultherapy-dubai/) may suit you better. See [how Morpheus8 Pro works and who it suits](/treatments/morpheus8-dubai/), or read about [recovery after Morpheus8](/blog/morpheus8-recovery-aftercare/).
prices: Face & neck, package of 3, per session
faq: Is PRP included in the Morpheus8 price?
Yes. Every Morpheus8 Pro session at Skin & Laser includes PRP.
Why is face and neck only AED 3,500 + VAT?
Treating both areas in one visit saves time, so the combined price is lower than booking them separately.
How much is a full Morpheus8 course?
For face and neck, the 3-session package is AED 5,250 + VAT in total. Body courses depend on the area and are confirmed at consultation.
